nodes.title: PuLID - DESCRIPTION
widgets_values:
PuLID Workflow:  
This workflow is designed for face cloning.  
- The *Load Image* node is used to load the face that you want to clone.  
- The *CN OpenPose* node is used to define the pose for the cloned face.

nodes.title: PuLID 2 faces - DESCRIPTION
widgets_values:
PuLID 2 Faces Workflow:
This workflow clones two faces and generates an image featuring both people. It is important that the prompt contains the words "2 people," "2 women," "2 men," or "couple." Otherwise, it will generate only one subject.

nodes.title: PuLID + IP adapter - DESCRIPTION
widgets_values:
PuLID + IP Adapter Workflow:
This workflow clones one face, uses one pose, and adopts the style from an image for the cloning process.
